headline: Brazil Lower House Approves 2027 Fiscal Adjustment Bill
summary: Brazil's lower house approved a bill introducing fiscal adjustments to public accounts for 2027. The measure allows the executive branch to limit spending and raise tax revenues to meet primary surplus targets.
why: Fiscal rules and primary surplus targets are key indicators of sovereign debt sustainability and macroeconomic policy in Latin America's largest economy.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: The fiscal adjustment bill modifies federal spending rules and primary surplus targets for the Brazilian government.
